scope: Internal unlinked fullyparked MAIN custody formatv3; coefficient-only format unchanged. No AIR, transcript, physical proof, guest or pool topology change.

integrity.framing: Header v3 binds original PCS root, exact column/native shapes and Merkle layer lengths. Chunking includes header and all coefficients/nodes, independent of segment boundaries. Segments must partition payload exactly; gaps, overlaps, overflow and incomplete coverage reject.
integrity.ownership: Borrowed existing source slices read until joined completion; positioned writes disjoint. Only after all writes/hash/fsync succeed are original coefficient/node owners retired. Restore hashes readonlymapping before any descriptor publication.

resources.ephemeral_heap: OneHash32B per4MiB chunk plusSegment descriptor per original column/layer/header; validated before allocation and charged through caller allocator; no tuple/witness/payload copy.
resources.scheduler: Existing scoped row_work pool, max16shards/min1chunk, no hidden pool or callback allocation; no-pool/cooperative fallback serial. All jobs join before error/cleanup.
resources.caps: At most256GiBpayload and65536segments; scratchBytes explicitly preflights arrays. Current128GiBStore admission and actual~2GiBworker payload below limits.
